introduction.value: Poster gave an autonomous agent a messy dataset with mixed formats, missing values and conflicts, and reports an 80% cut in research time, though cost was a complaint.

method.value: The poster stress-tested an autonomous agent on a messy research dataset with multiple file formats, inconsistent labels, missing values, and conflicting entries. They asked it to clean and standardize the data, detect anomalies, produce a structured summary, and suggest next research steps; the poster says human review was still needed because the agent could be too confident with ambiguous data.

outcome.value: They report cutting a task that usually took 4–5 hours down to about 45 minutes, roughly an 80% time reduction, and say it surfaced patterns and inconsistencies they had missed. The stated drawback was occasional overconfident interpretation, and a commenter also called Manus very expensive.

notes.value: The clearest catch is cost: a commenter said Manus was ridiculously expensive, while the poster says you still need human validation for high-stakes analysis.

source_text.body:
Research messy multi-format datasets autonomously
Poster gave an autonomous agent a messy dataset with mixed formats, missing values and conflicts, and reports an 80% cut in research time, though cost was a complaint.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The poster stress-tested an autonomous agent on a messy research dataset with multiple file formats, inconsistent labels, missing values, and conflicting entries. They asked it to clean and standardize the data, detect anomalies, produce a structured summary, and suggest next research steps; the poster says human review was still needed because the agent could be too confident with ambiguous data.
How it went
They report cutting a task that usually took 4–5 hours down to about 45 minutes, roughly an 80% time reduction, and say it surfaced patterns and inconsistencies they had missed. The stated drawback was occasional overconfident interpretation, and a commenter also called Manus very expensive.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch is cost: a commenter said Manus was ridiculously expensive, while the poster says you still need human validation for high-stakes analysis.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
I'm attaching a messy dataset about [topic] with mixed formats, missing values, and conflicting records: [files or links]. Clean and combine it, flag every conflict and gap with your reasoning for how you resolved it, and answer this question: [research question]. Done when you give me a cleaned file, a short findings summary, and a list of assumptions I should double-check. Tell me roughly how much work this will take before starting.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ManusOfficial/comments/1r81g13/autonomous_agent_reduced_my_research_time_by_80
